takeaways: Microsoft 365 governance is the balance between creativity, freedom and structure, and it works best in the background so people can collaborate without bureaucracy getting in the way.
Governance is a team sport that needs a leadership sponsor, IT and security, and line-of-business owners, with different rules for areas such as HR and legal than for sales or marketing.

Start early with basic policies such as naming conventions, ownership and lifecycle rules for Teams and guests, then monitor for drift and automate so sprawl stays under control as the organization grows.
hook: As Microsoft 365 grows, Teams, SharePoint sites and guest accounts multiply until collaboration turns into noise. In this interview, Heiko Brenn of BCC uses music metaphors to show IT leaders and governance owners how ownership, lifecycle management, monitoring and automation turn that sprawl into a well-coordinated orchestra.
